name: Kayleigh Glanzelius
original_name: ケイリ・グランセリウス
source:
Kayleigh, is one year under Kaoruko, calls herself a star princess. Her father is an Asian, her mother comes from North Europes. She has no experience of school life till entrance into the school, so she leads to friction in the school.
She understands is a non-standardized student in the school and she enjoys it; She played a mysterious girl in the first grade and intends to be feminine student without manful way of speaking in the second grade.
She is good at horoscope. She joins the swim club by her own fortune.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
